## About

Satya Sanatan Bastia is a Full Stack Developer based in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India.
He designs and builds modern, production-grade web applications from concept to deployment,
working across the entire stack — frontend, backend, databases, DevOps, and AI integration.

He is passionate about clean code, thoughtful UI/UX, and leveraging AI to deliver smart
user experiences. He is currently open to full-time software engineering roles and
freelance/contract projects worldwide.

## Featured Projects

### 1. VS Code-Inspired Developer Portfolio
A fully custom portfolio site inspired by the Visual Studio Code UI.
Built with Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Flask backend, PostgreSQL, and Render deployment.
Features: AI-powered chatbot, real-time git history visualisation, terminal emulator,
dark mode, smooth animations, and a complete admin dashboard.
**Stack:** Next.js · TypeScript · Flask · PostgreSQL · Docker · Redis · Render

### 2. AI-Powered Full Stack Applications
Multiple SaaS-style applications integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini) for intelligent
features such as smart search, document Q&A, auto-summarisation, and conversational UX.
**Stack:** React · Next.js · Python · FastAPI · LangChain · pgvector · Docker

### 3. E-Commerce & Dashboard Systems
End-to-end e-commerce platforms with product management, payment integration (Razorpay/Stripe),
order tracking, real-time analytics dashboards, and admin panels.
**Stack:** React · Node.js · PostgreSQL · Redis · AWS S3

### 4. Open-Source Contributions & CLI Tools
Various developer tools, npm/PyPI packages, and open-source contributions focused on
developer experience and automation.
